points.description: States that insertion sort processes/takes one element at a time, moving from left to right through the array (the current element is taken in turn, with the elements to its left forming the already processed part).
points.partial_credit: Half: says one element at a time but omits left-to-right order (or vice versa).

points.description: States that the taken element is inserted into its correct (right) position/place by comparing and shifting.
points.partial_credit: Half: says it is placed/moved but does not state it goes to its correct sorted position.

points.description: States that the insertion is among the already sorted elements on its left, i.e. the left part of the array is always sorted (sorted prefix/subarray), distinguishing it from selection sort or bubble sort (not selecting a minimum or swapping adjacent pairs repeatedly).
points.partial_credit: Half: mentions a sorted part but not that it is on the left, or says 'sorted elements' only vaguely.

rubric.notes: Full marks need all three elements stated precisely: one element at a time from left to right, inserted into its correct position, among the already sorted elements on its left. Part marks only if clearly more than half of a point is stated precisely. Vague descriptions such as 'it sorts by comparing elements', or confusing it with selection sort (picking the minimum) or bubble sort (swapping neighbours), earn nothing for the affected point.
